part.text: {"scores":[{"programme":1,"criterion":"fit","value":3,"reason":"The card measures capsid–receptor bind/no-bind calls and threefold geometry, but public ALPL, AAVR and LRP6 benchmarks only stand in for proprietary NR001–NR005 labels."},{"programme":1,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"A positive result could add an in-silico prefilter, but operational use requires proprietary NR-panel calibration and wet-lab validation; failure leaves current screening unchanged."},{"programme":1,"criterion":"new","value":3,"reason":"Public evidence supports experimental binding assays, not this exhaustive computational benchmark; proprietary labels leave possible prior internal pose enumeration unresolved."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"fit","value":3,"reason":"The outcome matches Lir’s docking calls and threefold QC, but public ALPL, AAVR and LRP6 results do not validate Starfish variants or proprietary assay labels."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Success could add extensive pose sampling and a pre-assay binding gate; failure preserves today’s surface-size tuning and laboratory gate."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"new","value":3,"reason":"Lir already performs receptor docking on Starfish surfaces, but lacks published bind/no-bind accuracy and the proposed 54-to-432-run scaling test."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"fit","value":5,"reason":"It directly scales the programme’s five-model AlphaFold-Multimer/SPR workflow with cryo-ET threefold-site scoring on capsid–receptor pairs."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Success could standardize hundreds of runs and let computed calls prioritize SPR and cryo-ET; failure leaves the current small-scale, assay-gated practice."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"new","value":3,"reason":"The proof-of-concept and Shay experiment already cover miniature classification and five-model site checks; only broader grid accuracy and compute scaling remain unanswered."}]}
